_comment: Golden samples captured from novelai.net: the PNG `Comment` tEXt chunk the server
writes into every image it returns. All three were rendered with NAI Diffusion V5
(model_hash DB276663). `signed_hash` was stripped; nothing else was edited.
The Comment is a FILTERED ECHO of the request, not the request itself. A field
missing here does not prove the website omitted it, and a field present does not
prove the client sent it - the server adds its own defaults. So the golden test
asserts only the intersection, and the two ignore lists below record which fields
are outside it and why. tools/nai_param_diff.py reads this same file, so the tool
and the test can never drift apart.

ignored_request_only._comment: Fields the plugin sends that the server never echoes. Absence from Comment is not evidence of a bug.
ignored_request_only.qualityPresetId: UI-state field; the server echoes the resolved tag_hint_qt instead
ignored_request_only.image: base64 payload, compared by decoding rather than by string

ignored_official_only._comment: Fields present in the Comment that no client sends - server-side or account-side.
ignored_official_only.signed_hash: server signature over the request; stripped from these samples
ignored_official_only.stream: transport negotiation (msgpack), not a generation parameter
ignored_official_only.model_name: server-side model identity, derived from the top-level `model` field
ignored_official_only.version: metadata schema version of the Comment blob itself
ignored_official_only.extra_passthrough_testing: NovelAI internal debug passthrough; all-null in every sample

_comment: Keys the server ADDS inside v4_prompt / v4_negative_prompt that no client sends.
Proof they are server-side, not a plugin omission: the echo carries all four keys in
both blocks, but v4_prompt.use_order is true while v4_negative_prompt.use_order is
false. A blanket server default would be false in both. What the echo actually shows
is exactly the shape the launcher sends (nai_image_request_builder.dart:275-291 puts
use_coords+use_order only in v4_prompt and legacy_uc only in v4_negative_prompt) with
every unsent key filled in as false. So novelai.net's own client sends this same
shape, and matching the echo key-for-key would mean sending MORE than the website.
ignored_nested_official_only.v4_prompt.legacy_uc: launcher sends legacy_uc at the top level of parameters only; server defaults it to false here
ignored_nested_official_only.v4_negative_prompt.use_coords: launcher sends use_coords in v4_prompt and at the top level, not in the negative block
ignored_nested_official_only.v4_negative_prompt.use_order: same; note the echo's false here vs true in v4_prompt is what proves these are defaults

samples.note: Quality tags on and the transparency tag auto-appended by the website. The base prompt ends with a literal \n\n which the website preserved before appending `, transparent background, very aesthetic, masterpiece, no text`.
Quality tags off (tag_hint_qt 0) and no transparency tag. The user typed `transparent_background,` into the prompt by hand instead, which is why the prompt still mentions it.
strength 0.4, noise 0.1, extra_noise_seed 1026 against seed 1027 - the seed relationship is what the img2img test pins down.
